title: Create relevance.py — multi-signal relevance scoring for prefetch
acceptance_criteria: compute_relevance_score(decision, task_text, weights) → float: weighted sum of impact, category_match, confidence_decay, semantic_similarity
match_categories(decision, task_text) → float: category overlap score 0.0-1.0 using _decision_matches_category pattern from packet_builder
compute_semantic_contribution(decision_text, task_text) → float: keyword overlap from rag._keyword_match_score pattern
DEFAULT_WEIGHTS dict with w_impact, w_category, w_confidence, w_semantic summing to 1.0
All functions pure: no I/O, same input = same output
